menu_path_issues: enable TUN: the path 'Home > Core Settings > TUN > Enable' is incomplete. In showClashSettingsTUN (group_helper.dart:2060-2090) the first switch is meta.overwrite (EN 'Overwrite', RU 'Переопределить', line 2074). The Enable switch has onSwitch null (disabled) unless Overwrite is on. The same Overwrite condition disables every other TUN item (lines 2118-2302). Correct path: Core Settings > TUN > turn on 'Переопределить' > turn on 'Включить'. Core Settings sub-item (line 1749) has no platform condition. The Network Check HTTP-via-TUN step needs configs.tun.enable (net_check_screen.dart:75-78) and otherwise shows 'TUN is not enabled' / 'TUN не включён'.

system proxy: the path 'Home > App Settings > Auto Set System Proxy when Connected' only exists on PC (Windows/macOS/Linux). It is hidden on iOS and Android (group_helper.dart:1516-1518). The default is on for Windows only.

change language: the sequence 'App Settings > Язык > Русский' is correct (group_helper.dart:1116; language_settings_screen.dart:277-283, which sets the locale and pops). The ordering note is wrong in its tail. After en, es, zhCn, zhTw, ru, fa, the rest follow AppLocale.values order from strings.g.dart (en, ar, es, fa, ja, ko, ru, zhCn, zhTw), so the tail is ar, ja, ko (عربي, 日本語, 한국어), not ja, ko, ar. Native names come from the locales map in en.i18n.json, so the labels are the same in any UI language.

add subscription sheet: 'Login' is shown always. For a CN region locale it comes before 'Add Profile Link', otherwise last. The sheet also has a first item 'Get Profile' ('Получить профиль'; on non-iOS 'Get Profile / Buy Profile' = 'Получить профиль / Купить профиль'), opening a web page. It is hidden when the provider sets hideRecommendMenu (profiles_board_screen.dart:180-230).

choose server: the path 'Connected > Home > Proxy' is correct. The Proxy row, Board, Runtime Profile and Network Check tiles are inside if (connected) (home_screen_widgets.dart:521-620). The Proxy screen header has the sort icon (tooltip 'Reorder'/'Отсортировать', toggling delayTestSort) and the lightning icon (tooltip 'Latency Checks'/'Обнаружение задержки'). Both are tooltip-only. 'Отсортировать' is a toggle for sorting by delay, not a one-off action.

update/share/QR/copy paths are correct: the more button is a three-dot icon (Icons.more_vert_outlined) in the profile row (profiles_board_screen_widgets.dart:228). Update, Copy Link and QR Code exist only for remote profiles. Copy Link, QR Code, and View/Edit are hidden when provider.hideNodeDetails is true. For a local profile the menu shows Edit instead of View, and no Update, Copy Link or QR Code.
missing_flows: Select the active profile: tapping a profile row in Профили/My Profiles calls ProfileManager.setCurrent and closes the screen (profiles_board_screen_widgets.dart onTap); rows are drag-reorderable. Not in the table.
Add-sheet item 'Get Profile / Buy Profile' (meta.getProfile / meta.buyProfile, 'Получить профиль / Купить профиль'; iOS shows only getProfile), listed above the other add methods.

Connecting and disconnecting transitions: while connecting, disconnecting or reasserting, only a spinner is shown over the switch. Traffic lines are shown only when connected. Both are correctly noted, but there is no text label for them.
Profile-needs-active alert (meta.profileNeedActive) when opening Proxy Groups from the profile editor while disconnected or with a non-active profile.
System tray (PC) uses meta.rule in main.dart:583 and likely other mode labels, so the mode switch is also available in the tray menu. Not verified further.
TUN 'Overwrite' switch (meta.overwrite = 'Переопределить') is the prerequisite for any TUN or DNS core setting. Without it Enable is greyed out.

Log Level in App Settings (group_helper.dart:1231) and Core Settings (1651) is listed only as a note. The Core Log viewer shows core stdout/stderr, last 50 KB (home_screen_widgets.dart:1185-1230), which matches the table.

Mode switch on mobile: the Rule/Global/Direct segmented button has no platform condition and works in both states; it calls ClashSettingManager.setConfigsMode and then refreshes the proxy. Confirmed, but the table does not say it applies instantly with no reconnect.
caveats: Source cloned shallow into the session scratchpad at tag v1.0.31.1703, which points directly at commit daef7be6c40d49a98a174a82c10599e163e71afd (release published 2026-10-09). The installed macOS app is 1.0.22, so labels may differ slightly; EN labels My Profiles, Import From Clipboard, Core Settings > TUN match the hint.

i18n uses the slang package: JSON files lib/i18n/{en,ru,...}.i18n.json with generated lib/i18n/strings*.g.dart. Keys are nested (meta.*, tun.*, NetCheckScreen.*). en and ru have the same 349 leaf keys, so no RU fallback to EN was found.

Several RU strings are odd and users will see them as is: Rule = 'Правила' (not 'Правило'), My Profiles = 'Профили', Proxy Group = 'Группа агентов', Reset = 'Перезагрузить', Latency Checks = 'Обнаружение задержки', Reorder = 'Отсортировать'. The assistant must quote these exactly.

There is no separate Subscription/Update All text button or System Proxy toggle on the home screen. Update-all, Add and Save are icon-only buttons whose only text is a tooltip. The per-profile actions live in a menu opened from a 'more' button on the profile row.

Proxy row, Board, Runtime Profile and Network Check tiles are built only while connected (home_screen_widgets.dart:521 if (connected)). Choosing a node and running a latency test therefore requires being connected.
Traffic counters are arrows plus numbers with no word labels. No separate connection-list screen was found in lib/screens. The 'Board' tile opens a web dashboard.
The home status text has only two states, Connected and Disconnected. Connecting and disconnecting show a spinner without text.

Platform differences were checked only partly by Platform.is* conditions: TV Mode is Android only; tun.allowBypass is Android only; appendHttpProxy is Android and iOS; Hide VPN Icon is iOS only; the system-proxy bypass list is PC only. Whether the QR scanner works on desktop was not verified.
The 'Add' sheet order and presence of 'Login' / 'Get Profile / Buy Profile' depend on device region (CN) and the current profile's provider settings.
Nothing was run: labels come from source and locale files only, not from screenshots of the app. No repo outside the temp scratchpad was touched.
